why: Intro to Git and GitHub plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-git.json), 'Fix a merge conflict' (passes: the last commit has two parents and no file holds conflict markers). The learner cleaned the markers out of pancakes.md in the editor but never ran `git add pancakes.md`, so `git commit -m "Merge branch 'add-syrup'"` stopped: 'Committing is not possible because you have unmerged files' and 'fatal: Exiting because of an unresolved conflict'. No merge commit exists (MERGE_HEAD is still there). The commit pattern only matches the learner's own typed message.

step.title: Finish the merge
step.instructions: Open pancakes.md, keep both toppings and delete the <<<<<<<, ======= and >>>>>>> lines. Then run git add pancakes.md and git commit to finish the merge.

files.cookbook/pancakes.md:
# Pancakes

- 1 cup flour
- 1 cup milk
- 2 eggs
- pinch of salt
- serve with maple syrup
- or a spoon of honey
